subject.title: fix(cli): protect protocol stdout during startup

question: Should this PR be refreshed to carry only the protocol-stdout startup fix before merge, or should maintainers accept the broad current head after exact merge-result proof?
rationale: The target fix is narrow and appears correct, but the latest head includes a large rebase snapshot and an exact-head scan failure; automation should not decide whether that branch shape is acceptable.

options.title: Refresh to the narrow fix

options.title: Accept the broad head with proof
